question: Can observed trend/relative strength decide when delaying a scheduled sell helps, without worsening later reversals?
known: All previous histories were seen. Prior late-all benefit in2025..June and failure afterJuly is known before this study. These are exploratory chronological tests, never untouched validation.

gates.late_trend: previous close > MA60 and MA120 > its value20 sessions ago
gates.late_relative: previous known20-session stock return > Shenzhen Component Index (399001) return and > Shennan Circuits return; Shennan is one peer proxy, not a sector index
gates.late_intraday: completed09:40-09:45 close > cumulativeVWAP, > session open, cumulative volume >= preceding20-session mean for09:45

delayedSell: Only daily target decreases. If gate qualifies at09:45, wait for first completed close < cumulative VWAP; execute following open, deadline11:00. Otherwise original09:45. Same/increased targets retain10:00. Base cash D or its full-target150% counterpart unchanged.
diagnosis: Continuous portfolios from2023-10-09; exact monthly log-relative-wealth contributions; separately replay each changed session twice from identical baseline prior-close cash/shares, including holiday interest before start, T+1 shares, dividends and same execution constraints. Replayed baseline must match original end NAV.
selection: Freeze at2024-12-31. Rank annualized log growth minus1.5*abs5minDD, require20 delayed sessions in training and trainingDD not worse than original by2pp, otherwise keep original. Select cash and finance separately.
acceptance: Incremental candidate must beat original in2025..June2026 AND July..Oct8, not increase DD by>2pp in either, beat original under10bp slip in both, not lower older-period return, and beat original in>=2 of3 fixed anniversary years. Full cash objective additionally requires beating100% hold with DD<=75% of hold; new forward evidence still required for promotion.
boundaries: All windows freshly funded for period performance; monthly and paired replay diagnosis instead use continuous accounts. Sixvariants x two capital policies =12, ofwhich8 are new gated schedules. All results retained.
